paragraphs: He is mentioned in Bamidbar Rabbah 11:3.[^1]

notes.text: The heading's ברבי is retained as beRabbi, without identifying a father. The stored Midrash Rabbah — TE at Bamidbar Rabbah 11:3 explicitly has Rabbi Tanchum beRabbi, son-in-law of Rabbi Simlai; this supports the two Rabbi expansions and the relationship direction for this occurrence. The earlier son of Rabbi title remains superseded.
